caption: A · The brief, Create (Desk 1440 × 900): Type in the brief: the shape redraws on the pause.
A · The brief, Create (Phone 390 × 844): The brief typed on the phone, its shape read under it.
A · The brief, Edit (Desk 1440 × 900): Line 6 is not read as a step: it is highlighted and goes to the orchestrator as prose.
A · The brief, Edit (Phone 390 × 844): The workflow opened under its row: line 6 goes as prose, the shape under it.
A · The brief, Run and see runs (Desk 1440 × 900): Run 8 in the Split, the shape lit by its work items; the asking node’s question opens under it.
A · The brief, Run and see runs (Phone 390 × 844, screen 1 of 2): The workflow's runs: run 8 needs you, then the routine's runs before it.
A · The brief, Run and see runs (Phone 390 × 844, screen 2 of 2): Run 8 opened: the shape lit, and step 4's question under it.
A · The brief, Evaluate (Desk 1440 × 900): Checks are sentences scored on each run’s reports; each mark is one run.
A · The brief, Evaluate (Phone 390 × 844): The checks, each mark one run.
A · The brief, Delete (Desk 1440 × 900): The row’s ⋯ holds every way to manage it; Delete asks in place and names what it reaches.
A · The brief, Delete (Phone 390 × 844, screen 1 of 2): The row's ⋯ open: every way to manage the workflow.
A · The brief, Delete (Phone 390 × 844, screen 2 of 2): Delete asks in place under its row, naming its runs, its routine and the run still going.
B · Step ledger, Create (Desk 1440 × 900): Rows by hand, or Caw’s draft kept row by row. Press Add a step.
B · Step ledger, Create (Phone 390 × 844): On the phone: the name, the brief and the rows by hand; Ask Caw to draft it is in the foot.
B · Step ledger, Edit (Desk 1440 × 900): A Call row opened in place: its connection, tool, arguments and when it is approved. Ledger | Shape swaps the rows for their picture.
B · Step ledger, Edit (Phone 390 × 844): The Call row opened in place: x-use, get_tweet, its argument and when it is approved.
B · Step ledger, Run and see runs (Desk 1440 × 900): Run 8 is the same ledger, lit. Press the asking row: its question folds and unfolds in place.
B · Step ledger, Run and see runs (Phone 390 × 844, screen 1 of 2): The workflows, then their runs: run 8 needs you.
B · Step ledger, Run and see runs (Phone 390 × 844, screen 2 of 2): Run 8 opened: the step rows lit, step 4's question unfolded under its row.
B · Step ledger, Evaluate (Desk 1440 × 900): The run’s checks, plus a step’s own “Done when”, scored on that step’s report alone.
B · Step ledger, Evaluate (Phone 390 × 844): The run's checks, then step 5's own check, not run yet.
B · Step ledger, Delete (Desk 1440 × 900): The row’s ⋯ and the delete asked in place, naming the runs and the routine it reaches.
B · Step ledger, Delete (Phone 390 × 844): Delete asked in place under the workflow's row, each row keeping its ⋯.
C · Canvas, Create (Desk 1440 × 900): A blank canvas from its Start node, with the tray. Press Agent in the tray: the first node joins under Start.
C · Canvas, Create (Phone 390 × 844): On the phone the new canvas is a picture of its Start node; steps are added as a list under it.
C · Canvas, Edit (Desk 1440 × 900): Click a node: the inspector changes to it in place.
C · Canvas, Edit (Phone 390 × 844): Read-only on the phone: the canvas with Read via x-use chosen, its settings under it.
C · Canvas, Run and see runs (Desk 1440 × 900): Run 8 lights the same canvas; the asking node’s question stands in the inspector.
C · Canvas, Run and see runs (Phone 390 × 844): Run 8 on the phone: the canvas lit, step 4's question under it.
C · Canvas, Evaluate (Desk 1440 × 900): A check can be pinned to a node and scored on that node’s report.
C · Canvas, Evaluate (Phone 390 × 844): The checks, one of them pinned to Read via x-use.
C · Canvas, Delete (Desk 1440 × 900): Draft and published versions beside the canvas; Delete asks under them.
C · Canvas, Delete (Phone 390 × 844): The canvas, its draft and live versions, then Delete asking what it reaches.
D · Keep a run, Create (Desk 1440 × 900): Run 7’s finished tree and its ⋯ › Keep as workflow. Press it: the tree travels into the ledger and becomes the row.
D · Keep a run, Create (Phone 390 × 844, screen 1 of 2): A finished run, Oct 21's, with its ⋯ open on Keep as workflow.
D · Keep a run, Create (Phone 390 × 844, screen 2 of 2): Kept: the tree is now the workflow's steps and brief, ready to prune or run.
D · Keep a run, Edit (Desk 1440 × 900): Pruning the kept tree. Press Remove on “Draft up to 3 DMs”.
D · Keep a run, Edit (Phone 390 × 844): The kept tree on the phone, pruned the same way.
D · Keep a run, Run and see runs (Desk 1440 × 900): Run 8 beside what was kept: a step the orchestrator added is marked, with Keep.
D · Keep a run, Run and see runs (Phone 390 × 844): Run 8 against the kept run: the added step marked, step 4's question open.
D · Keep a run, Evaluate (Desk 1440 × 900): Every run is scored against the kept run (a pinned baseline).
D · Keep a run, Evaluate (Phone 390 × 844): The checks, each scored against run 7, the kept run.
D · Keep a run, Delete (Desk 1440 × 900): Manage adds “Keep run 2 instead”: another good run becomes the next version.
D · Keep a run, Delete (Phone 390 × 844, screen 1 of 2): The row's ⋯ open, with Keep run 2 instead.
D · Keep a run, Delete (Phone 390 × 844, screen 2 of 2): Delete asks in place under its row, naming what it reaches.
